```{r}
simulate <- function(N, n, R, s){
  set.seed(s)
  
  estimate <- numeric(R)
  
  for(times in 1:R){
    mysample <- sample(1:N, n)
    
    estimate[times] <-  0.8 * (max(mysample) + sd(mysample))
  }
  
  estimate
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
hist((simulate(500000, 20, 1000, 123)))

```

```{r}
hist((simulate(100, 20, 1000, 123)))
```
```{r}
hist((simulate(40, 20, 1000, 123)))
```
